audit.whatIsWrong: The content layer claims LeBlanc wins all seven stages while the full layer's phases[].side reads Irelia/Irelia/Irelia/Irelia/Skill/Skill/Irelia. The page renders two opposite answers to 'who wins Level 1', and a 50.04% win rate over 2280 games does not support a clean sweep in either direction.
audit.why: Irelia's Bladesurge (Q) is a 600-range dash costing 15 mana that refreshes off Marked or dying targets, so she has a repeatable gap-closer from level 1; LeBlanc's only escape is Distortion (W) on 15s at rank 1. Early stages belong to Irelia. Level 6 and first item are genuinely skill: Mimic doubles LeBlanc's chain, Vanguard's Edge Marks and slows.
audit.corrected: win[0..3] -> Irelia, win[4..5] -> Skill, win[6] -> Irelia, matching phases[].side, with each whys[] rewritten to argue the same verdict.

audit.whatIsWrong: spikes[] invented mechanics: 'stack four Q (Bladesurge) marks', 'passive shield stacks', 'Hiten Style sustain', and 'single-cast Ionian Fervor stun-and-slash'. Irelia has no Hiten Style, no shield, no four-stack Q requirement, and Ionian Fervor is a stacking attack-speed passive, not a stun.
audit.why: Riot's text: passive grants stacking bonus Attack Speed on spell hits; Bladesurge refreshes if the target is Marked or dies; the stun is Flawless Duet (E); Vanguard's Edge (R) Marks, damages and forms a slowing wall.
audit.corrected: Spikes rewritten around the real spikes: Flawless Duet Mark -> free Bladesurge reset (lvl 3), Vanguard's Edge at 125/105/85s (lvl 6), Grievous Wounds vs Bladesurge healing (1st item).

audit.whatIsWrong: The decisive interaction was never stated. Flawless Duet (E) both stuns and Marks; a Marked target refreshes Bladesurge, so one landed E converts into repeated free dashes. Nothing on the page said this. Ethereal Chains' 1.5s shackle-to-root window against her dash was also unstated.
audit.why: Enemy kit E text: 'Enemies caught in between are damaged, stunned and Marked.' Q text: 'If the target is Marked or dies to Bladesurge, its cooldown refreshes.' Owner E text: shackle roots after 1.5s.
audit.corrected: breakdown.cooldowns, spikes[0], mid, dosFull[1] and dontsFull[2] now carry the E-Mark-to-Bladesurge chain, the real 16s/10s E cooldown, and the Ionian Fervor attack-speed reason not to trade autos.

audit.whatIsWrong: breakdown.cooldowns contained no digit at all (lint COOLDOWN_NO_DIGIT) and was pure template.
audit.why: Flawless Duet is 16/14.5/13/11.5/10s; Bladesurge is 10/9/8/7/6s but refreshes for free on Marked or dying targets.
audit.corrected: Rewritten with both numbers and the instruction to count her E rather than her Q.

notes: Chart flipped to match the full layer's phases[].side, which was already Irelia-weighted; the content layer's all-LeBlanc sweep was the wrong half and contradicted a 50.04% win rate over 2280 games. No phases[].side edits were needed (they already read correctly), so all chart edits are win[N]+whys[N] pairs. Defiant Dance (W) reduces PHYSICAL damage only per Riot's text, so it does not blunt LeBlanc's magic burst — worth stating on a later pass if a field opens up. Vanguard's Edge carries a 'terrain: blocks paths and dashes' derived flag, but Riot's description only says the wall damages and slows; I wrote the slow, not a dash block.
